title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia
overview: After crash-landing on Earth, two royal teen aliens on the run struggle to blend in with humans as they evade intergalactic bounty hunters.

title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir
overview: Marinette and Adrien, two Parisian teenagers, are entrusted with powerful jewels in order to transform into superheroes Ladybug and Cat Noir. But neither hero knows the other's true identity — or that they're classmates!

title: Baby Animal Cam
overview: Keep an eye on the daily routines, quirky habits and cozy habitats of several baby animals at Cleveland Metroparks.

title: Easy-Bake Battle: The Home Cooking Competition
overview: Talented home cooks put their skills and creativity to the test making fast and easy dishes that are wildly delicious — and worthy of a big cash prize.

title: Geek Girl
overview: Awkward teen Harriet has always wanted to fit in. Until she gets scouted by a top London model agent and learns that some people are meant to stand out.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
overview: Mighty teen Adam and his heroic squad of misfits discover the legendary power of Grayskull — and their destiny to defend Eternia from sinister Skeletor.

title: Holly Hobbie
overview: Holly's a 13-year-old singer-songwriter who's got her best friends and close-knit family by her side, but she's dreaming of ways to save the world - even if it's starting in her own backyard.

title: Is It Cake? Holiday
overview: Cake artists from past seasons return to craft tasty replicas of ice skates, nutcrackers and more in this holiday spin on the mind-bending baking contest.

title: Island of the Sea Wolves
overview: Explore wild, wondrous Vancouver Island, where the ocean nurtures all life, from bald eagles who go fishing to sea wolves who swim in frigid waters.

title: Jentry Chau vs the Underworld
overview: As her 16th birthday approaches, a not-so-average teen rediscovers the fiery powers she's long suppressed and is forced to face her demons — literally.

title: Kid Cosmic
overview: A boy's superhero dreams come true when he finds five powerful cosmic stones. But saving the day is harder than he imagined — and he can't do it alone.

title: Luz: The Light of the Heart
overview: Raised by a kind Kaingang family, adventurous young schoolgirl Luz launches a quest with her firefly companion to learn the truth about her roots.

title: Making Fun
overview: Grumpy expert maker Jimmy DiResta fields kids' ideas for delightfully pointless inventions. Then — if he's in the mood — he and his pals build 'em.

title: Malibu Rescue: The Series
overview: On the heels of Junior Rescue training, Team Flounder returns to brave the beach in a series of thrilling saves and lighthearted laughs.

title: Night on Earth
overview: This nature series’ new technology lifts night’s veil to reveal the hidden lives of the world’s creatures, from lions on the hunt to bats on the wing.

title: No Good Nick
overview: A family finds their lives turned upside down when a young, street-smart grifter shows up on their doorstep, claiming to be a distant relative.

title: Our Living World
overview: This stunning nature series narrated by Cate Blanchett explores the intelligence, resourcefulness and interconnectedness of life on our planet.

title: Rebel Cheer Squad: A Get Even Series
overview: The old DGM might have left Bannerman School, but their spirit remains, and there is still a need to get even, wrongs must be righted and injustice has to be fought.

title: Secret World of Sound
overview: Anthony Morgan explores the extraordinary ways that animals hear and produce sound, and the crucial role sound plays in the lives of animals around the globe - from birth to surviving adulthood and finding a mate.

title: Shaun the Sheep: The Flight Before Christmas
overview: Shaun's seasonal excitement turns to dismay when a farmhouse raid to get bigger stockings for the flock inadvertently leads to Timmy going missing. Can Shaun get Timmy back before he becomes someone else’s present?

title: Sugar Rush
overview: A relentlessly fast-paced baking competition that challenges brilliant bakers to create sweet treats that look and taste amazing – all against the clock. Who will race to the finish and win $10,000?

title: The Big Nailed It Baking Challenge
overview: In this high-stakes "Nailed It!" spinoff competition, 10 novice bakers pick up tips from professional coaches while vying for a sweet cash prize.

title: The Secret Life of Our Pets
overview: With the help of the latest science and new camera technology, this exciting show reveals that our pets are hiding incredible superpowers and quirks of evolution.

title: Transformers: War for Cybertron: Earthrise
overview: While Megatron takes drastic measures to save the Decepticons, the Autobots fight to save all of Cybertron from both on the planet and aboard the Ark.

title: Transformers: War for Cybertron: Kingdom
overview: The frantic race to locate the Allspark first culminates on a strange planet as the future comes crashing through to the present day.

title: Transformers: War for Cybertron: Siege
overview: On their dying planet, the Autobots and Decepticons battle fiercely for control of the AllSpark in the Transformers universe's origin story.

title: Ultimate Beastmaster
overview: In this intense obstacle course series, elite athletes from the U.S. and other countries compete for cash prizes, individual glory and national pride.

title: Masters of the Universe: Revelation
overview: The war for Eternia begins again in what may be the final battle between He-Man and Skeletor. A new animated series from writer-director Kevin Smith.

title: My Dad the Bounty Hunter
overview: An intergalactic bounty hunter takes dad duty to new extremes when his two kids accidentally hitch a ride with him to outer space and crash his mission.

title: Wizards: Tales of Arcadia
overview: Merlin’s apprentice joins Arcadia’s heroes on a time-bending adventure in Camelot, where conflict is brewing between the human, troll and magical worlds.

title: Baby Gorilla Cam
overview: Peek into the gorilla habitat at Cleveland Metroparks, where two new babies are adapting to life in the troop.

title: Chimp Empire
overview: A vast community of chimpanzees thrives in a forest in Uganda, navigating complex social politics, family dynamics and dangerous territory disputes.

title: Attenborough's Life in Colour
overview: Exploring the vital role colour plays in the daily lives of many species.

title: Life on Our Planet
overview: Life's extraordinary journey to conquer, adapt and survive on Earth across billions of years comes alive in this groundbreaking nature docuseries.

title: Man vs Bee
overview: Bumbling dad Trevor tries to get the best of a cunning bee while house-sitting a posh mansion — but only unleashes more chaos in this comedy series.

title: Our Great National Parks
overview: Narrated by former President Barack Obama, this stunning docuseries shines the spotlight on some of the planet's most spectacular national parks.

title: Our Universe
overview: Witness the remarkable story of our universe over billions of years and its inextricable link to life on Earth in this sweeping documentary series.

title: Asterix & Obelix: The Big Fight
overview: When their druid forgets how to prepare the magic potion, Asterix and Obelix must defend the village as Caesar plots to use a Gallic law against them.

title: Little Witch Academia
overview: When she was a little girl, Atsuko "Akko" Kagari saw a magic show performed by a witch named Shiny Chariot.  From that day on she wanted to be just like her.  Enrolling at Luna Nova Magical Academy and having no magical background, can she become a witch like her idol Shiny Chariot?

title: Lost Ollie
overview: A patchwork rabbit with floppy ears and fuzzy memories embarks on an epic quest to find his best friend — the young boy he desperately loves.

title: Maya and the Three
overview: A spirited princess with the heart of a warrior embarks on a mission to fulfill an ancient prophecy and save humanity from the wrath of vengeful gods.

title: ONI: Thunder God's Tale
overview: In a mystical world of Japanese gods and spirits, a courageous girl strives to follow in her mysterious father's footsteps and find her true powers.

title: Scaredy Cats
overview: On Willa Ward’s twelfth birthday, she inherits a beautiful charm necklace that belonged to her mother, who was a witch.  She soon learns 2 bad witches, Wilma and Wanda are after her locket so they can have ultimate power, and she alongside her best friends Scout and Lily turn into cats to escape.

title: The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance
overview: Return to the world of Thra, where three Gelfling discover the horrifying secret behind the Skeksis' power and set out to ignite the fires of rebellion and save their world.

title: The New Legends of Monkey
overview: Follow a teenage girl and a trio of fallen gods on a perilous journey as they attempt to bring an end to a demonic reign of chaos and restore balance to their world. Inspired by the 16th Century Chinese fable “Journey to the West.”
